draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.80, the 207th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 25th of 37 at CB. He lasted until pick 237, well after his grade rank (207th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 6 passes defended in 2021, 11th of 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 33 career games and 0 starts over 3 completed seasons. Producing near his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2023. Weak spots: season snap share 9.0% (16th percentile), approximate value 1 (17th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 cornerback who played: 9.0% season snap share against a median of 34.8%, below the norm.
